messages:
Zoe L.: Heads-up: supply-chain vendor pen-test booked 2026-06-20 10:00-14:00 UTC. They will request artifact access and may ask to decrypt a small set of sample builds for repro. Need chain-of-custody, SBOM handling, ephemeral RBAC, KMS wrapping policy, and retest slots. Who picks up?

Hank R.: I'll take artifact access model. Proposal: put signed build artifacts in a readroom bucket with object-lock enabled. Vendor gets presigned GETs only; no console or list perms. If they need decryption, we use a short-lived KMS grant with strict usage audit and rotate after.

Tess M.: I'll own audit export and evidence manifest. Plan: snapshot CloudTrail + codebuild logs at T+0 and T+end, export to forensics bucket with checksum. Also capture signature verification entries.

Zoe L.: Compliance asks for SBOMs to be redacted of internal secrets and to be uploaded via presigned PUT only. No direct artifact uploads from vendor into production buckets.

compliance-bot: Requirement: if external principal obtains Decrypt rights, use HSM-backed KMS key and rotate keys post-engagement. Log KMS:Decrypt and GenerateDataKey operations to SIEM.

Hank R.: IAM/role sketch for vendor readroom:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-readroom/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-readroom/*"}
  ]
}
```

Hank R.: Presign examples: GET TTL 48h for readroom, PUT TTL 24h for SBOM ingest. KMS grant pattern: create-grant with Encrypt/GenerateDataKey for uploads; only allow Decrypt after documented approval. Record grant ID in tracker and call retire-grant at session end.

Tess M.: Suggested retest slots: 2026-06-24 13:00-15:00 UTC and 2026-06-25 09:00-11:00 UTC. I'll reserve on calendar and put slots in tracker. Tracker URL: https://redwood/secure/pt-tracker/SC-1022 (internal).

Zoe L.: Action items: Hank = implement role + presign automation and object-lock policy; Tess = audit snapshots + evidence manifest; Compliance to confirm HSM key availability and rotation requirement. infra-bot: create preflight reminder for 2026-06-19 16:00 UTC.

infra-bot: Preflight created: "SC-1022 preflight" 2026-06-19 16:00 UTC. Invite sent to participants.

Zoe L.: Thanks team. We'll reconvene at preflight to validate scripts and confirm grant retirement automation.
